name: Shadow Sorcery

source.note: Entered from the 2025 Unearthed Arcana (Horror Subclasses) and published reviews of Ravenloft: The Horrors Within; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Sorcerers whose power seeps up from the Shadowfell, bending darkness, undeath and misfortune to their will.

feature.name: Eyes of the Dark
feature.summary: Darkvision 120 feet and Blindsight 10 feet; you see through the Darkness of your own spells.
feature.text: Senses: Darkvision 120 ft and Blindsight 10 ft. Darkness created by your own spells doesn't hamper your sight.

feature.name: Shadow Spells
feature.summary: Bane, Darkness, Inflict Wounds and Pass without Trace always prepared; more at levels 5, 7 and 9.
feature.text: Always prepared from the Sorcerer level shown: 3 Bane, Darkness, Inflict Wounds, Pass without Trace; 5 Hunger of Hadar, Summon Undead; 7 Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer; 9 Contagion, Creation.

feature.name: Spirits of Ill Omen
feature.summary: Summon Undead needs no Material component and is free once per Long Rest; you can cast it without Concentration (1 minute).
feature.text: Summon Undead needs no Material component from you, and one casting per Long Rest needs no slot. Any casting can drop Concentration if you choose as you begin: it then lasts 1 minute and ends if you cast the spell again.

feature.name: Shadow Walk
feature.summary: Bonus Action in Dim Light or Darkness: teleport up to 120 feet to another dim or dark space.
feature.text: Cost: a Bonus Action, standing in Dim Light or Darkness. Teleport up to 120 ft to a free space you can see that is itself dim or dark.

feature.name: Umbral Form
feature.summary: Bonus Action: shadow form for 1 minute (Resistance to all but Force and Radiant, move through creatures, a Charisma save to stay up at 0). Once per Long Rest or 6 Sorcery Points.
feature.text: Cost: a Bonus Action. For 1 minute (ending early if you're Incapacitated or choose to) you are living shadow: Resistance to every damage type but Force and Radiant; you pass through creatures as Difficult Terrain, taking 1d10 Force damage if a turn ends with you inside one; and when you would fall to 0 Hit Points without dying, a Charisma save (DC 5 + half the damage) leaves you at three times your Sorcerer level instead. Recharges on a Long Rest, or at once for 6 Sorcery Points (free).
